            <div class="rwp-webpart__subtitle rwp-webpart__title--centered">Learn even more about how Dell supports developers and DevOps teams.</div>
                         


	<div class="rwp-faq">
			<div class="rwp-faq-item">
				<div class="rwp-faq-item__question">
					<h3 class="rwp-faq-item__heading">
						<button type="button" class="rwp-faq-item__button active" id="in-en-bsd-821c676d-669e-4c9e-8f32-6ebdead958b7-devops-solutions-tab5-wp2-button-1" aria-expanded="true" data-metrics="{}"

							What DevOps enablement tools and integrations does Dell support?
							<svg version="1.1" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true" data-icon-name="chevron-down" class="rwp-icon icon-color-Blue  " viewBox="0 0 32 32">
<path d="M30.48 7.24l-14.48 14.48-14.48-14.48-1.52 1.52 16 16 16-16z"></path>
</svg>
						</button>
					</h3>
				</div>

				<div class="rwp-faq-item__answer" aria-labelledby="in-en-bsd-821c676d-669e-4c9e-8f32-6ebdead958b7-devops-solutions-tab5-wp2-button-1" role="region" id="in-en-bsd-821c676d-669e-4c9e-8f32-6ebdead958b7-devops-solutions-tab5-wp2-answer-1">
					<div class="rwp-faq-item__answer--content " >
						<div class="rwp-faq-item__answer--copy">
							<div>Dell offers a wide range of DevOps enablers including RESTful APIs, SDKs (Python, Java, PowerShell), Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform and Ansible, and CI/CD pipeline compatibility with platforms such as Jenkins and GitLab.</div>
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>
			</div>
			<div class="rwp-faq-item">
				<div class="rwp-faq-item__question">

							How can I automate infrastructure provisioning using Dell solutions?
							<svg version="1.1" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true" data-icon-name="chevron-down" class="rwp-icon icon-color-Blue  " viewBox="0 0 32 32">
<path d="M30.48 7.24l-14.48 14.48-14.48-14.48-1.52 1.52 16 16 16-16z"></path>
</svg>
						</button>
					</h3>
				</div>

				<div class="rwp-faq-item__answer" aria-labelledby="in-en-bsd-821c676d-669e-4c9e-8f32-6ebdead958b7-devops-solutions-tab5-wp2-button-2" role="region" id="in-en-bsd-821c676d-669e-4c9e-8f32-6ebdead958b7-devops-solutions-tab5-wp2-answer-2">
					<div class="rwp-faq-item__answer--content rwp-faq-item__answer--hidden" >
						<div class="rwp-faq-item__answer--copy">
							<div>Dell provides Terraform providers and Ansible modules that allow users to automate provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management of Dell infrastructure. Documentation and sample playbooks are available to help you get started.</div>
						</div>
					</div>
				</div>

Dell offers a wide range of DevOps enablers including RESTful APIs, SDKs (Python, Java, PowerShell), Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform and Ansible, and CI/CD pipeline compatibility with platforms such as Jenkins and GitLab. How can I automate infrastructure provisioning using Dell solutions? Dell provides Terraform providers and Ansible modules that allow users to automate provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management of Dell infrastructure. Documentation and sample playbooks are available to help you get started. Where can I find documentation and sample code for Dell’s APIs and SDKs? All official documentation, code samples, and usage guides for Dell’s APIs and SDKs are available on the Dell Developer Portal and GitHub repositories. These resources include authentication guides, endpoint references, and best practices. How do I get support or report issues with Dell’s DevOps solutions? <script>
(function () {
  // Prevent duplicate execution (important for modals)
  if (window.__tilesScriptInitialized) return;
  window.__tilesScriptInitialized = true;

  const TILE_SELECTOR = '[id*="wp-tiles"]';
  const ITEM_SELECTOR = '.rwp-contentlayout-item';

  /* ------------------------------
     Accordion behavior
  ------------------------------ */

  // Delay ensures modal content is fully mounted
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.querySelectorAll(".rwp-contentlayout").forEach((accordion) => {
      const items = accordion.querySelectorAll(ITEM_SELECTOR);

      const closeAll = () => {
        items.forEach((i) => {
          i.classList.remove("is-open");

          const content = i.querySelector(".rwp-contentlayout-copy-container");

          i.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
          if (content) content.style.removeProperty("max-height");
        });
      };

      items.forEach((item) => {
        const trigger = item;
        const content = item.querySelector(".rwp-contentlayout-copy-container");

        if (!content) return;

        const contentId = `accordion-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;

        trigger.setAttribute("role", "button");
        trigger.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
        trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        trigger.setAttribute("aria-controls", contentId);
        content.id = contentId;

        const toggleItem = () => {
          const isOpen = item.classList.contains("is-open");
          closeAll();

          if (!isOpen) {
            item.classList.add("is-open");
            trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
            content.style.maxHeight = `${content.scrollHeight}px`;
          }
        };

        trigger.addEventListener("click", toggleItem);
        trigger.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " " || e.key === "Spacebar") {
            e.preventDefault();
            toggleItem();
          }
        });
      });
    });
  }, 300); // modal timing fix

  /* ------------------------------
     Image presence flags
  ------------------------------ */
  const tiles = document.querySelectorAll(TILE_SELECTOR);
  const webparts = document.querySelector("#webparts");

  let anyHasImages = false;

  tiles.forEach((tile) => {
    const items = tile.querySelectorAll(ITEM_SELECTOR);

    items.forEach((item) => {
      const hasImages = !!item.querySelector("img");

      item.classList.toggle("has-images", hasImages);
      item.classList.toggle("no-images", !hasImages);

      if (hasImages) anyHasImages = true;
    });
  });

  if (webparts) {
    webparts.classList.toggle("tiles-has-images", anyHasImages);
    webparts.classList.toggle("tiles-no-images", !anyHasImages);
  }

  /* ------------------------------
     Link disable flags
  ------------------------------ */
  document
    .querySelectorAll('a[href^="javascript:void(0)"]')
    .forEach((link) => {
      link.classList.add("link-disabled");
      link.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
      link.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
    });

  console.log("Product Line HML --- v1.1 script loaded");
})();
</script>

<script>
/**
 * CPP V2.5 Nav: URL‑driven selection + mobile dropdown behavior
 */
(function () {
  const SECTION_SELECTOR = '[id*="cpp-v2-nav"].cp-container';
  const GRID_SELECTOR = "section > div.grid-gap";
  const KEYWORDS = ["laptops", "desktops", "monitors"];

  const section = document.querySelector(SECTION_SELECTOR);
  if (!section) return;

  const grid = section.querySelector(GRID_SELECTOR);
  if (!grid) return;

  /* ---------------- Utilities ---------------- */

  const isMobile = () => window.matchMedia("(max-width: 768px)").matches;

  const tiles = () => Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll(".grid-item"));

  const selectedKeyFromUrl = () => {
    const url = location.href.toLowerCase();
    return KEYWORDS.find((k) => url.includes(k)) || KEYWORDS[0];
  };

  const findTileByKey = (key) => {
    const k = (key || "").toLowerCase();
    const list = tiles();

    return (
      list.find((t) => {
        const a = t.querySelector("a.link-tag");
        return a?.href?.toLowerCase().includes(k);
      }) ||
      list.find((t) => (t.dataset.key || "").toLowerCase() === k) ||
      list.find((t) => (t.id + " " + t.className).toLowerCase().includes(k)) ||
      list[0]
    );
  };

  /* ---------------- Link State ---------------- */

  const disableLink = (tile) => {
    const a = tile?.querySelector("a.link-tag");
    if (!a) return;

    if (!a.dataset.originalHref && a.hasAttribute("href")) {
      a.dataset.originalHref = a.getAttribute("href");
    }

    a.removeAttribute("href");
    a.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
    a.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
    a.style.pointerEvents = "none";
    a.classList.add("is-disabled-link");
  };

  const enableLink = (tile) => {
    const a = tile?.querySelector("a.link-tag");
    if (!a) return;

    if (a.dataset.originalHref) {
      a.setAttribute("href", a.dataset.originalHref);
    }

    a.removeAttribute("aria-disabled");
    a.removeAttribute("tabindex");
    a.style.pointerEvents = "";
    a.classList.remove("is-disabled-link");
  };

  const applySelection = () => {
    const selected = findTileByKey(selectedKeyFromUrl());

    tiles().forEach((t) => {
      t.classList.toggle("is-selected", t === selected);
      t === selected ? disableLink(t) : enableLink(t);
    });

    return selected;
  };

  /* ---------------- Mobile Dropdown ---------------- */

  let trigger = null;

  const open = () => {
    grid.classList.replace("dropdown-collapsed", "dropdown-expanded");
    trigger?.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");

    tiles().forEach((t) => {
      if (t !== trigger) t.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
    });
  };

  const close = () => {
    grid.classList.replace("dropdown-expanded", "dropdown-collapsed");
    trigger?.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");

    tiles().forEach((t) => {
      if (t !== trigger) t.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    });
  };

  const toggle = () =>
    trigger?.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true" ? close() : open();

  const onKey = (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggle();
    }
  };

  const onOutsideClick = (e) => {
    if (isMobile() && !section.contains(e.target)) close();
  };

  const bindTrigger = (el, panels) => {
    trigger?.removeEventListener("click", toggle);
    trigger?.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);

    trigger = el;
    trigger.setAttribute("role", "button");
    trigger.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");
    trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    trigger.setAttribute("aria-controls", panels.map((p) => p.id).join(" "));

    trigger.addEventListener("click", toggle);
    trigger.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
  };

  const applyMobile = (selected) => {
    const otherTiles = tiles().filter((t) => t !== selected);

    selected.style.order = "1";
    otherTiles.forEach((t, i) => {
      t.style.order = String(i + 2);
      t.classList.add("panel-member");
      t.id ||= `cpp-v2-nav--panel-item-${i + 2}`;
      t.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    });

    grid.classList.add("dropdown-collapsed");
    bindTrigger(selected, otherTiles);

    document.removeEventListener("click", onOutsideClick);
    document.addEventListener("click", onOutsideClick);
  };

  const destroyMobile = () => {
    tiles().forEach((t) => {
      t.style.order = "";
      t.classList.remove("panel-member");
      t.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
    });

    grid.classList.remove("dropdown-collapsed", "dropdown-expanded");

    if (trigger) {
      trigger.removeEventListener("click", toggle);
      trigger.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
      trigger.removeAttribute("role");
      trigger.removeAttribute("tabindex");
      trigger.removeAttribute("aria-expanded");
      trigger.removeAttribute("aria-controls");
      trigger = null;
    }

    document.removeEventListener("click", onOutsideClick);
  };

  /* ---------------- Responsive Driver ---------------- */

  let mobileApplied = false;

  const evaluate = () => {
    const selected = applySelection();

    if (isMobile()) {
      applyMobile(selected);
      mobileApplied = true;
    } else if (mobileApplied) {
      destroyMobile();
      mobileApplied = false;
    }
  };

  evaluate();
  window.addEventListener("resize", evaluate);
  window.addEventListener("orientationchange", evaluate);
})();

/**
 * Hero headline responsive font sizing
 */
(function () {
  const TITLE_SELECTOR =
    "[id*=wp-hero].cp-container .rwp-contentlayout-item__title";

  const mq1440 = matchMedia("(min-width: 1440px)");
  const mq1920 = matchMedia("(min-width: 1920px)");
  const mq2560 = matchMedia("(min-width: 2560px)");

  const observers = new WeakMap();

  const fontScales = () =>
    mq2560.matches
      ? [96, 72, 64, 56, 48]
      : mq1920.matches
        ? [72, 64, 56, 48]
        : [64, 56, 48];

  const fits = (el) => {
    if (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth) return false;

    const lineHeight = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).lineHeight);
    return el.scrollHeight <= lineHeight * 2;
  };

  const applyBestSize = (el) => {
    for (const size of fontScales()) {
      el.style.fontSize = size + "px";
      if (fits(el)) return;
    }
  };

  const enable = (el) => {
    applyBestSize(el);

    const container = el.closest("[id*=wp-hero].cp-container");
    if (!container) return;

    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => applyBestSize(el));
    ro.observe(container);
    observers.set(el, ro);
  };

  const disable = (el) => {
    el.style.fontSize = "";
    observers.get(el)?.disconnect();
    observers.delete(el);
  };

  const update = () => {
    document
      .querySelectorAll(TITLE_SELECTOR)
      .forEach((el) => (mq1440.matches ? enable(el) : disable(el)));
  };

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", update);
  [mq1440, mq1920, mq2560].forEach((mq) =>
    mq.addEventListener("change", update),
  );
})();

/**
 * Group hero + image/tiles/products into a product-group
 */
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  document.querySelectorAll('.cp-tabset__tab-content').forEach(section => {
    if (section.querySelector('.product-group')) return;

    const children = [...section.children];
    let group = [];

    children.forEach((el, i) => {
      const id = el.id || '';
      const next = children[i + 1];
      const nextId = next?.id || '';

      if (id.includes('wp-hero')) {
        group.length && wrap(group, section);
        group = [el];
      } 
      else if (group.length && /wp-(image|tiles|products)/.test(id)) {
        group.push(el);

        if (id.includes('wp-tiles') && nextId.includes('wp-products')) {
          return;
        }

        if (id.includes('wp-tiles') || id.includes('wp-products')) {
          wrap(group, section);
          group = [];
        }
      }
    });

    function wrap(nodes, parent) {
      const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
      wrapper.className = 'product-group';

      parent.insertBefore(wrapper, nodes[0]);
      nodes.forEach(n => wrapper.appendChild(n));
    }
  });

  // Apply alternating background classes to product groups
  document.querySelectorAll('.product-group').forEach((group, i) => {
    group.classList.add(i % 2 === 0 ? 'bg-odd' : 'bg-even');
  });
});

            <script>var dellScriptLoader = (function () {
	"use strict";

	var scriptsArray = [];
	var urlRegex = /^(https:\/\/www\.|https:\/\/|\/\/|\/)?[a-z0-9]+([\-\.]{1}[a-z0-9]+)*\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?(\/.*)?$/; //exit if not a url or an array

	function scriptsArrayCopy() {
		return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(scriptsArray));
	}

	//check for valid url
	function isValidUrl(url) {
		return typeof url === "string" && urlRegex.test(url);
	}

	//check for array
	function isValidArray(scripts) {
		return Array.isArray(scripts);
	}

	function load(scripts) {
		if (!(isValidUrl(scripts) || isValidArray(scripts))) {
			return;
		}

		//single url being passed
		if (isValidUrl(scripts)) {
            scriptsArray.push(scripts);
            return;
		}

		//handling of array
		if (isValidArray(scripts)) {
			for (var i = 0; i < scripts.length; ++i) {
				var _script = scripts[i];

				//if array of strings
				if (typeof _script === "string" && isValidUrl(_script)) {
                    scriptsArray.push({ url: _script });
                    continue;
				}

				//if array of objects with url and order
                if (_script.hasOwnProperty("url") && _script.hasOwnProperty("order") && !isNaN(Number(_script.order))) {
					_script.order = Number(_script.order);
					scriptsArray.push(_script);
					continue;
				}

				//if array of objects with only url
                if (_script.hasOwnProperty("url") && isValidUrl(_script.url)) {
                    scriptsArray.push(_script);
                    continue;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	return Object.freeze({
		load: load,
		scriptsArrayCopy: scriptsArrayCopy
	});
})();
